answer_3.quote: We adopt a common practice having GPT-4 judge which of two model-created mnemonics is higher quality . GPT-4 has 80% agreement with users (Appendix B.3) on 200 held-out mnemonic pairs.
methods: pairwise evaluation using GPT-4 as a judge
GPT-4 classifier to compare winning vs losing mnemonics

answer_4.quote: We have two mnemonic researchers assess our mnemonics, split into keyword and explanation quality. For keyword quality, we ask two yes/no questions: 1) Does the keyword sound like the term? (Phonetic Similarity); 2) Is the keyword simpler than the term? (Simplicity). For explanation quality, we rate mnemonic explanations out of five on: 1) Clarity; 2) Strength; 3) Imageability.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators answered yes/no questions about phonetic similarity and simplicity for keywords, and rated explanations on clarity, strength, and imageability.
